argyrītis , ĭdis, f., = ἀργυρῖτις (containing silver),
I.a kind of silver dross, litharge of silver, Plin. 33, 6, 35, § 106.‡ † argyrŏcŏrinthĭus , a, um, adj., made of Corinthian brass (which was similar in lustre to silver; cf. Plin. 34, 2, 3): CRATERA, Inscr. (A. D. 149) Orell. 1541.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
